article.headline: Deke Thompson totals 20 points, 10 rebounds to lead Omaha over Jacksonville State 78-69
article.description: — Deke Thompson finished with 20 points and 10 rebounds to lead Omaha to a 78-69 victory over Jacksonville State on Friday night at the Resorts World Classic.
article.linkText: Deke Thompson totals 20 points, 10 rebounds to lead Omaha over Jacksonville State 78-69
article.story: LAS VEGAS -- — Deke Thompson finished with 20 points and 10 rebounds to lead Omaha to a 78-69 victory over Jacksonville State on Friday night at the Resorts World Classic. Thompson hit four 3-pointers and handed out four assists for the Mavericks (4-5). Grant Stubblefield added 19 points and seven rebounds. Justin Bolis scored 15 on 7-for-8 shooting, and Dace Pleasant scored 12 off the bench on 4-for-8 shooting from 3-point range. Leon Horner and Chris Lockett Jr. both scored 16 to lead the Gamecocks (4-5), who took a 34-32 lead into halftime. Up next: Omaha will host Mount Marty on Tuesday, the same day Jacksonville State entertains Little Rock. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here
